entities.name: Myriocin
observations: Fungal metabolite and sphingolipid-biosynthesis inhibitor; HSV-2 cell-culture study reports promotion of replication at nanomolar concentrations.

entities.name: HSV-2 infection
observations: In cell culture, myriocin accelerated HSV-2 replication; 30 nM increased infectious virus production by approximately 1.7 log; mechanism was not identified.

entities.name: PMID:25447452
observations: Wang et al., Life Sciences 2015;120:31-38. Cell-culture experiments found myriocin promoted HSV-2 replication, detectable at 3 nM and plateauing near 30 nM; infectious virus production rose approximately 1.7 log at 30 nM.
